visualCharacteristics: Sits in a light-grey section (#f2f2f2) whose top padding is 50px and bottom ~0 (section height 161px on desktop for 2 rows). A plain list, no bullets: 3 columns (33.33% each) from 768px, 1 column below. Each link: block, 18px myriad-pro weight 400, black, padding 1px 10px 4px, border-left 4px solid #000, margin-bottom 15px per item; hover: white text on black background with the left border #f16c51. Active link (the section in view, or the one clicked) gets class "active". Fonts: body 'myriad-pro' (fallback Arial) 18px weight 300 line-height 1.45; headings 'tungstenw05-medium' (fallback Oswald, then sans-serif) weight 500. The Infosys font files are commercial and must NOT be copied into this public repo: use font-family stacks 'myriad-pro, arial, sans-serif' and 'tungstenw05-medium, oswald, sans-serif' through CSS custom properties (--infosys-body-font, --infosys-heading-font) defined on the block (or body.infosys), and load Oswald from Google Fonts as the heading fallback only if the project already loads web fonts that way; otherwise rely on the stack. Content width: centred 1170px container from 1200px wide (970px from 992px, 750px from 768px), 15px side padding, full width below 768px.
contentPattern: Container block; child item "infosys-jumplink" with fields link (aem-content) and linkText (text); each published row holds one <a>. JS: turns bookmark://x and https://#x hrefs into #x; target ids: a section whose section metadata "anchor" is x is found as .section[data-anchor="x"] and given id x (decorateSections stores section metadata as data-* attributes); smooth scroll with scroll-margin-top 100px (fixed header); marks the active link on scroll.
usage: In-page navigation to sections that set the section Anchor field (e.g. day2), usually in a Light grey section under the banner.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any list of in-page anchors; link targets are section anchors or element ids.
